Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security
Sponsor: Stadthagen
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 01/17/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 21 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, local jails, the district attorneys, the Department of Corrections, the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles, and community corrections by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Allen Treadaway, Chair
Public Safety and Homeland Security
